_readme: Chapter 6 inference tasks. One registry for every task across the four
quadrants (shape × head). The chapter entry points pick a task via a
TASK constant at the top of the notebook (or --task on the CLI runner).
Each task entry layers on top of config.json's shared block: later wins.
Keys starting with '_' are documentation; the engine strips them before
model_name='auto' triggers a trace-file lookup at

fp._notes: Filled-pause detection with the CLASSLA FP-BERT model. Postproc per the model card: drop short peaks + edge events.

primary_stress._notes: Primary-stress detection. Postproc keeps short peaks and edge events: a stressed vowel is often 60-100 ms and initial/final stress is legitimate. 'auto' resolves via models/_best_models/primary_stress.json.
